author: T.F.Z22

title: Effective though a bit too complex
body:
Very good app, very effective and helpful with staying away from the phone. Very relaxing music and vibe.

The only thing that I’m disappointed with is the friend interaction part. It’s impossible to help out a friend with their nursery. It’s way too expensive. It feels pointless though it has so much potential. If we could “pitch in” to help out the friend with some rain drops of our choosing. It would be more interactive and nice ❤️ hopefully this part can be updated soon.
